source: https://twac.immigration.gov.tw/ (homepage, who submits), https://twac.immigration.gov.tw/files/UserManual_Eng.pdf (official English user manual), https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5382/5385/7229/7238/415735 (current 7-day submission window, extended July 2026), https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5382/5385/7445/392097/392128/cp_news (the arrival card is free) and https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141457/142068/398041 (online-only from 1 October 2025), all read 2026-08-30. The manual names the collected items and which are conditional. It publishes one format only, DD/MM/YYYY for the departure date. No HTML validation attributes, character limits or error messages were readable for the live form, so none are claimed below and no pattern key appears.

email_verification.label: Email verification
email_verification.placeholder: An inbox you can open during the trip
email_verification.help: The manual confirms an email verification step before the form opens, and a confirmation email or electronic document after submission. Use an address you control.

passport_entry.label: Passport upload or manual entry
passport_entry.placeholder: Upload the passport, or type the values
passport_entry.help: The manual offers a passport upload or manual entry. Either way, the values must match the passport carried on the trip, because the record is retrieved by passport scan at inspection.

nationality.label: Nationality
nationality.placeholder: As shown in the travel document
nationality.help: Nationality is collected by the arrival card. Enter it as the travel document shows it, not as the country you flew from.

passport_expiry.label: Passport expiry
passport_expiry.help: Passport expiry is collected. Copy the date from the passport data page. A renewed passport is a different document and needs its own submission.

visa_type_number.label: Visa type and number (conditional)
visa_type_number.help: The manual marks visa type and number as conditional. They appear for travellers whose entry route requires them, and stay hidden for everyone else.

occupation.label: Occupation or job title (conditional)
occupation.help: Occupation and job title are also conditional in the manual. Answer them when the form presents them, using your actual role.

phone.label: Phone number
phone.placeholder: A number reachable during the trip
phone.help: A phone number is collected alongside the email. Use a number that can be reached during the visit rather than one you will switch off on landing.

arrival_transport.label: Arrival flight or vessel
arrival_transport.placeholder: The flight or vessel you arrive on
arrival_transport.help: The manual collects the arrival flight or vessel. Use the operating service for the segment that lands in Taiwan.

errors.required: The arrival flight or vessel is required

departure_transport.label: Departure flight or vessel
departure_transport.placeholder: The flight or vessel you leave on
departure_transport.help: The departure flight or vessel is collected in the same section. It is asked at submission time, so have the onward booking to hand.

errors.required: The departure flight or vessel is required

departure_date.label: Departure date
departure_date.help: The manual gives the departure date format as DD/MM/YYYY. This is the one format the official document states; the guide does not invent formats for the other date fields.

purpose.label: Purpose of visit
purpose.placeholder: The real purpose of the trip
purpose.help: Purpose of visit is collected. Choosing Other opens a reason field, and choosing to visit relatives opens a relative contact field.

accommodation.label: Accommodation
accommodation.placeholder: Where you are staying in Taiwan
accommodation.help: Accommodation is collected in the same section as the travel details. Give the address or property for the stay.

relative_contact.label: Relative contact (conditional)
relative_contact.help: The manual adds a relative contact field when the purpose is visiting relatives. It does not appear for other purposes.
